Once the batatas are soft, take them out of the pan. In the same pan, add a little more azeite if needed, and put in your flaked bacalhau. Let it sauté for just a few minutes until it's heated through and smells wonderful.

Now, the magic! Gently fold the cooked batatas and cebola into the bacalhau. Mix it all up with love.

And for the finishing touch, crack your ovos right into the pan, on top of the bacalhau and batatas. Cover the pan again for just a minute or two, until the ovos are cooked just the way you like them. Some people like them runny, some like them firm. You choose, meu querido!
